test_title: PYST 03: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 04 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bide one’s time

options.text: To wait patiently for an opportunity
To join a popular trend or activity
To face a difficult situation with courage and determination

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To wait patiently for an opportunity. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Bide one’s time"** means: • To wait patiently for an opportunity. (धैर्यपूर्वक अवसर का इंतजार करना) • **Example:** She decided to bide her time and wait for the perfect moment to make her move. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To wait patiently for an opportunity. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To join a popular trend or activity** (लोकप्रिय प्रवृत्ति या गतिविधि में शामिल होना) • **Example:** Many people decide to join the bandwagon when a new trend emerges. • **Option 3: To face a difficult situation with courage and determination** (साहस और दृढ़ता के साथ कठिन परिस्थिति का सामना करना) • **Example:** Despite the challenges, she faced the situation with courage and determination. • **Option 4: To accidentally reveal a secret** (गलती से एक रहस्य प्रकट करना) • **Example:** He accidentally let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party. 38:T988, The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
